title: when your Baby Girl Ragdoll kitten meets your Rottweiler Chops at the disco. 😹😻😍❤️
description:
Welcome to our cosy corner of YouTube where you can enjoy some lighthearted pet-related videos. ❤️✨️

This short shows our Purdy A.K.A Madame as a tiny kitten with our second Rottweiler Chops. 😍❤️ She was nearly all white and soooo adorable. 😻❤️😍
When we got her we had a massive Rottweiler called Chops. He was huge, hench in fact! He also looked the part if you didn't notice his teeth...to be honest you couldn't miss them! It looked like he was smiling. 😁❤️😍 He was comical but I think all Rottweilers are effortlessly comical. They have adorable expressive faces. 😍❤️ 
Madame Swish soon had him wrapped around her floofy mitts. 😹😻😍  She would curl up and go to sleep on his massive doggo bed and he would lay beside on the cold slate floor. 🥹😍❤️
He was an extremely strong dog who quite literally fought his way through Parvo when he was still a puppy. He was so very ill, we didn't think he would make it, but he did thankfully. ❤️ He was on a drip at the vets during the day and I was up all night with with giving him sugar water. All the garden had to be bleached constantly too. Because he was such a strong dog he pulled through like a champ. The vet said the same. He must have been a strong dog because he ate things that no one should eat! 😂 Whereas our George is a big delicate flower! 😂😍So I think that when we got George, Madame Swish thought ohhh another big daft doggo I can  definitely control!!! 😹😹😹❤️😍 And the rest is history as they say. ❤️😍

If our furbabies made you smile, please like, share and subscribe.
Thank you for watching. We appreciate it.
If you have time, feel free to take a cheeky sneaky peek at our other videos!

🐕 A woof and some drool from George
🏎️ A rev from Elon
👑 And a hiss from Purdy
